The present Appeal has been filed by the Insurance Company under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988, against the Award dated 17.11.2022, passed by the learned Motor Accident Claims Tribunal/ Additional District Judge, Khatima, District Udham Singh Nagar in Motor Accident Claim Petition No.107 of 2019, "Smt. Visna Devi and Others vs. IFFCO Tokio General Insurance Company Ltd. and Others", by which, the learned Tribunal has awarded a total sum of Rs.66,14,824/- as compensation alongwith an interest at the rate of 7% per annum from the date of petition till its actual payment.
Heard Mr. H.C. Pande, learned counsel for the appellant.

sentences.text: Steps to be taken within a week.
Learned counsel for the appellant requested four weeks' time to deposit Rs.40,00,000/- (Rupees Forty Lakhs) against the awarded amount.

Subject to depositing of Rs.40,00,000/- (Rupees Forty Lakhs) before the Tribunal concerned within a period of four weeks from today, the effect and operation of the impugned Award dated 17.11.2022 are stayed till disposal of this Appeal.
Stay Application (IA No.01 of 2023) is disposed of accordingly.

(Alok Kumar Verma, J.) 17.02.2023 Pant/
